parameters.content:
## Drive folder classification
Only folder links are accepted. Right after Drive List Files the folder is classified:

A  images only -> 3-level vision fallback (Groq > Gemini > Groq)
B  1 video, no images -> Gemini File API (full video)
C  2+ videos, no images -> error
D  images + 1 video -> vision fallback for images, then Gemini File API for the video
E  images + 2+ videos -> error
Empty folder -> error

Video path: upload start > download from Drive > upload bytes > poll until ACTIVE > generateContent(fileUri) > Build Groq Request.
Tip: set N8N_DEFAULT_BINARY_DATA_MODE=filesystem on the n8n instance so large videos stay on disk.
